notes.title: 🛠️ Patch Notes - [Version v0.01.2]
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello everyone!![/h3][p]We would like to [i]thanks to all the feedback[/i] received through our Form and Steam Community. We're constantly working to improve the experience, and every piece of feedback is welcome so please consider responding to our feedback form.[/p][p] [b][i]It really helps us improve the experience as we continue development![/i][/b][/p][p][url="https://forms.gle/BRx2HqkdvZ6ALSLMA" style="button" buttoncolor="#551392"]FORM HERE[/url][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45559095/791b9b4b59dd04e51a85707e526047cd722eb45b.png"][/img][/p][h3]• [b][i]Language[/i][/b][/h3][p]All texts, cutscenes, dialogues, and style rankings in Portuguese have now been translated into English.[/p][h3]• [b][i]Combat[/i][/b][/h3][p]Previously, we had not added Screen Shake when taking hits from enemies, now it has been added and it is working.[/p][h3]• [b][i]Visuals[/i][/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]UI[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]All tutorial texts have been fixed and improved.[/p][list][*][p][b]Too many Trees[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]Most of the trees were removed to increase visibility during the fighting.[/p][list][*][p][b]Depth of Field[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]We added a graphic feature that causes a blur effect on some elements of the scene. This feature had not been implemented previously because it was not ready yet.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45559095/1eaa99202cd73e5fc0aee9ecdaae33ee6c050c39.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]Power Increase[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]The character caused less damage than expected in the initial tests, the correction was made so that the tutorial would take less time.[/p][list][*][p][/p][p][b]Defense Increase[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]We noticed that a low amount of Defense could be detrimental to the tutorial stage[/p][list][*][p][b]Screen Shake Fix[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]A bug caused the character's attacks to not trigger screenshake.[/p][list][*][p][b]Light Slash 3 Animation[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]The recovery time for Thaynara's Light Slash 3 has been increased as it was too fast.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45559095/1e5193202b0e3823942a1b7ceb128f54a0d8182b.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]Light Slash[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We’ve decreased the distance traveled when using Melee 2, making it easier to perform combos with Apoema.[/p][list][*][p][b]Skills without Cooldown[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]Apoema did not have a cooldown on his skills, now all of his skills have a cooldown after being used.[/p][list][*][p][b]Power Dunk[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]The altitude of this skill was changed so that more hits can be landed during the attacks.[/p][list][*][p][b]Front Kick[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]The distance that Apoema traveled during the casting of this skill was changed so that it is easier to form combos with this skill.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45559095/964af39f9ff7078b56cbbfd446465ad6aaaab304.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]Light Slash 1 e Light Slash 2[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]The distance the character traveled after using Light Slash 1 and Light Slash 2 was changed to make gameplay easier and the character's ability to perform combos.[/p][list][*][p][b]Skill Cooldown[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]All of Uyara's skill cooldowns were making it harder to create combos with her.[/p][p]
Thank you for playing Lumina!💜[/p][p]— LongNight Studios Team [/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45559095/749e9605e35489bb1cfe19c4119f5e3cca125421.jpg"][/img][/p]
